target_pdb.description: Optional target structure (.pdb). When provided, the adapter runs in macrocyclic-binder mode; otherwise monomer macrocycle mode.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when omitted.

target_chain.description: Target chain id on `target_pdb`. Used only when `target_pdb` is provided.

target_residues.description: Optional target residue range `<start>-<end>`. FASTA/sequence 1-indexed when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy structure residue range.

target_hotspots.description: Optional target hotspot positions. FASTA/sequence 1-indexed when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy PDB residue numbers.

target_sequence.description: Reference target sequence for mapping integer positions to PDB residue IDs.

target_fasta_path.description: FASTA file containing the target sequence; alternative to inline `target_sequence`.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer position inputs: `auto` chooses sequence when a target sequence is provided, else structure.

peptide_length.description: Fixed length of the macrocyclic peptide chain (head-to-tail cyclic). Typical 7-15 residues.

num_designs.description: Number of peptide designs to sample.

num_diffusion_steps.description: RFdiffusion `diffuser.T` parameter; number of diffusion timesteps.

noise_scale.description: Translation+rotation noise scale during sampling. Lower means tighter, less diverse.
